basic_details.job_title: DIO iDEAL Internship Program Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The iDEX Defence Exploration and Learning (iDEAL) Internship Program at DIO pays a monthly stipend of INR 30,000 for a 6-month internship and INR 20,000 for a 3-month internship, with work in person at the DIO office in New Delhi. Final-year undergraduates, graduates and postgraduate students of science and engineering/technology degree programmes, aged not above 26 years as on 30-11-2026, can apply online at idex.gov.in until 30 November 2026; the internship is tentatively set to begin on 4 January 2027.

how_to_apply: Apply only in online mode through the application form at https://idex.gov.in/d/s/form/ideal_internship_November_2026. Applications received through any other mode will not be considered.
Students should obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC), where applicable, from their college or institution in the format of Annexure 1.
Submit the application on or before 30 November 2026.

No Objection Certificate (Annexure 1, applicable to students): given on letterhead and signed by the HOD/Principal. It certifies that the applicant is a bonafide student, that the institution has no objection to the applicant joining the program from January 2027 for 3 or 6 months, that the student is not registered for any course requiring class attendance in that period, and that the student's conduct has been found satisfactory.
important_instructions: The internship is in-person; all interns must be physically present at the designated DIO office during the internship period. Office timings are 09:30 AM to 06:00 PM, Monday to Friday, and interns are expected to follow them. Regular attendance is mandatory, and interns must maintain punctuality and professionalism. Besides official holidays as per the organization's calendar, interns are entitled to six days of leave for a 6-month internship and three days for a 3-month internship.

content_sections.heading: About the iDEAL Internship
content_sections.text: iDEX Defence Exploration and Learning (iDEAL) is a stipend-based 3-month and 6-month internship program. It aims to give students exposure and practical experience in managing projects focused on niche technology development in Defence and Aerospace. The notice describes the internship as neither a job nor an assurance of a job with the Authority.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The program at DIO is generally open to Indian citizens with the specified educational qualification from a recognized University. Undergraduate students in their final year, or those who have graduated from a degree program for science and engineering/technology in the year of application. Postgraduate students, pursuing or graduated in the year of application, with the bachelor's qualification applicable as in the point above. Age: should not exceed 26 years as on 30-11-2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates who have undergone or are undergoing Apprenticeship Training under NATS or NAPS in any other establishment or organization are not eligible. Suppression of facts and furnishing false information lead to disqualification or rejection of candidature, and canvassing in any form results in disqualification. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The maximum duration of the internship can be extended on need basis. Interns who complete the program are eligible for an experience certificate issued by iDEX/MoD. Interns would receive defence-related technology project management experience through diverse responsibilities and regular evaluations and feedback. Interns who demonstrate exceptional skills, dedication and a strong fit in the iDEX ecosystem may be offered relaxation(s) in the recruitment process of iDEX-DIO as deemed suitable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DIO iDEAL Internship Program
content_sections.text: Apply only in online mode through the application form at https://idex.gov.in/d/s/form/ideal_internship_November_2026 . Applications received through any other mode will not be considered. Students should obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC), where applicable, from their college or institution in the format of Annexure 1. Submit the application on or before 30 November 2026. No Objection Certificate (Annexure 1, applicable to students): given on letterhead and signed by the HOD/Principal. It certifies that the applicant is a bonafide student, that the institution has no objection to the applicant joining the program from January 2027 for 3 or 6 months, that the student is not registered for any course requiring class attendance in that period, and that the student's conduct has been found satisfactory.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DIO iDEAL Internship Program 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of applying for the internship is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the iDEAL internship?
faq.answer: Indian citizens who are final-year undergraduates or graduates of a science and engineering/technology degree program in the year of application, or postgraduate students pursuing or graduated in that year with the same bachelor's applicability.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the iDEAL internship?
faq.answer: The age of the candidate should not exceed 26 years as on 30-11-2026.

faq.question: Q4. How much stipend does the iDEAL internship pay?
faq.answer: The stipend is INR 30,000 per month for the 6-month internship and INR 20,000 per month for the 3-month internship.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the iDEAL internship?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted only online through https://idex.gov.in/d/s/form/ideal_internship_November_2026. Applications received through any other mode will not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Is the iDEAL internship a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice states the program is neither a job nor an assurance of a job with the Authority, though exceptional interns may be offered relaxation(s) in the iDEX-DIO recruitment process as deemed suitable.

faq.question: Q7. Who is not eligible for the iDEAL internship?
faq.answer: Candidates who have undergone or are undergoing Apprenticeship Training under NATS or NAPS in any other establishment or organization are not eligible.

faq.question: Q8. Is a No Objection Certificate required?
faq.answer: The NOC in the Annexure 1 format, signed by the HOD/Principal on letterhead, applies to students, as marked "if applicable" in the notice.

faq.question: Q9. What are the working hours and leave for interns?
faq.answer: Office timings are 09:30 AM to 06:00 PM, Monday to Friday. Interns get six days of leave for a 6-month internship and three days for a 3-month internship, besides official holidays.
